summary: A clear practice list, WhatsApp and phone access are strengths, but three firm names, conflicting figures and no appointment form appear to cost you clients.

findings.problem: The firm appears as Abdulla M. Al-Mulla Law Firm, Abdulla M. Al-Mulla Advocates and Legal Consultancy and Legal Abdulla Law Firm, and phone numbers appear as +974 3000 9998 and +974 400 20 200.
findings.cost: Changing names and numbers confuse clients and weaken search visibility.
findings.fix: One firm name and one checked number.

findings.problem: Book an Appointment appears three times but points to an anchor, and no contact or appointment form is visible.
findings.cost: Clients who want to book online have no simple way and some will leave.
findings.fix: A real appointment form with confirmation.

findings.problem: The page claims 500+ Cases Handled, Cases Won 500+, 98% Success Rate and Client Satisfaction 100%, and the office hours say Sunday to Thursday while it also claims 24/7 Legal Support.
findings.cost: Conflicting figures reduce trust in a law firm.
findings.fix: One verified set of figures and clear hours.

findings.problem: Every practice card ends with the leftover label Professional Grade, the call link tel:+974 3000 9998 contains spaces, and no testimonials or bar admissions appear.
findings.cost: Leftover labels, a risky phone link and thin proof weaken credibility.
findings.fix: Clean cards, a tested call link, testimonials and credentials.

redesign: One firm name, one number and a real appointment form with WhatsApp.
One verified set of figures and clear opening hours.
Credentials, testimonials and clean practice pages.
